title: LLM Fine-Tuning
blurb: Prepare chat data, mask the loss to the assistant's turns, train low-rank adapters, and see what QLoRA changes about memory.
intro: Supervised fine-tuning teaches a pretrained model a format and a behaviour from example conversations. The steps follow the data and the parameters: render conversations with a chat template and find the assistant spans, turn those spans into a loss mask, train and merge LoRA adapters on a frozen layer, quantise the frozen weights to NF4 the way QLoRA does, and size the memory of the whole fine-tune. The capstone takes one LoRA SGD step on a tiny language model with the assistant-only loss.
